LanguageData.TM_AlterStorm.description: Alters the weather to create new conditions. Rainy storms will be changed to healing rain. Snow will be changed to a hailstorm. The hailstorm can be partially controlled by directing the hail towards enemies on the map, but once this weather even is started it must run its course and cannot be influenced by rainmaker.
LanguageData.TM_AlterStorm.label: Alter Storm
LanguageData.TM_ArcaneBarrier.description: Creates an arcane barrier at the target location that is horizontal to the caster. The barrier lasts 60 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_ArcaneBarrier.label: Arcane Barrier
LanguageData.TM_ArcaneBolt.description:
Launches a bolt of raw arcane energy. This ability will slowly grow in power based on the casters magic level.
Arcane Bolt is inefficient because of the unrefined nature of the spell, but it can be learned and cast by any mage capable of violence.
LanguageData.TM_ArcaneBolt.label: Arcane Bolt
LanguageData.TM_BlankMind.description:
Wipes the memories of a pawn and breaks them out of any mental state but will induce a brief period of confusion as they gather their wits. When used on enemies, it will apply a mental freeze, stunning the enemy for a brief period.
AoE effects are only applied when the primary target is not a friendly pawn. Friendly pawns will lose both good and bad memories.
LanguageData.TM_BlankMind.label: Blank Mind
LanguageData.TM_Blur.description: Additional 20% chance to avoid all attacks by distorting light around the caster. Requires 20 mana to sustain and reduces mana regeneration by 10%. Re-use the ability to deactivate blur.
LanguageData.TM_Blur.label: Blur
LanguageData.TM_BriarPatch.description: Creates a hazard made of thorny vines. Any movement over the affected area will be slowed, and creatures moving through the briar patch may take minor damage.
LanguageData.TM_BriarPatch.label: Briar Patch
LanguageData.TM_CauterizeWound.description: The fire mage invokes elemental fire to instantly cauterize wounds on a patient. However, this process is likely to leave burn scars.
LanguageData.TM_CauterizeWound.label: Cauterize Wounds
LanguageData.TM_ChargeBattery.description: Converts raw magic power into electrical energy. This spell can only be used on batteries or golems. Generates 400Wd.
LanguageData.TM_ChargeBattery.label: Charge Battery
LanguageData.TM_Cooler.description: Creates a dimensional pocket that taps into the Plane of Ice, reducing heat in a confined area. The cooler must be sustained by the mage - reduces max mana by 25 while active.
LanguageData.TM_Cooler.label: Magical cooler
LanguageData.TM_DirtDevil.description: Create a small vacuum of elemental air that seeks out and vaporizes dirt and debris.
LanguageData.TM_DirtDevil.label: Dirt Devil
LanguageData.TM_Discord.description:
A channeled ability that continually assaults the senses of the victim with random and jarring signals. This sensory overload will gradually weaken mental stability and eventually the mental harmony of the target will collapse altogether. The results of this ability vary, but will grow stronger with each iteration.
Effects include dizziness, nausea, vision and hearing loss, vomiting, inability to determine friend from foe, can no longer maths, dislike of other pawns, loss of motor skills, loss of reason, urge to discuss politics, paroxysm, brain hemorrhaging and cranial detonation. Results may vary when targeting friendly pawns. Consult your therapist channel before using.
LanguageData.TM_Discord.label: Discord
LanguageData.TM_DismissCooler.label: Dismiss Cooler
LanguageData.TM_DismissFertileLands.description: Releases the druid's power infusing the land with fertility.
LanguageData.TM_DismissFertileLands.label: End Fertile Lands
LanguageData.TM_DismissHeater.label: Dismiss Heater
LanguageData.TM_DismissLightningTrap.label: Dismiss Lightning Trap
LanguageData.TM_DismissPowerNode.label: Dismiss Power Node
LanguageData.TM_DismissSunlight.label: Dismiss Sun Light
LanguageData.TM_DryGround.description: Infuses the ground with heat, evaporating most of the moisture from a patch of ground. Only works on muddy ground.
LanguageData.TM_DryGround.label: Dry Ground
LanguageData.TM_EMP.description: Generate a burst of electromagnetic radiation at a target site, disabling mechanoids for a short period.
LanguageData.TM_EMP.label: EMP
LanguageData.TM_Extinguish.description: Removes the fire element from the target location, instantly extinguishing undesired fires.
LanguageData.TM_Extinguish.label: Extinguish
LanguageData.TM_FertileLands.description: Infuses an area of land with power from the druid that increases its fertility. This ability must be maintained and reduces mana regeneration by 40%. The druid is limited to one area.
LanguageData.TM_FertileLands.label: Fertile Lands
LanguageData.TM_Flight.description: Quickly fly to a target location.
LanguageData.TM_Flight.label: Flight
LanguageData.TM_HeatShield.description: Place a heat barrier on allies that provides 75% bonus protection against heat damage and prevents catching on fire. Effects up to 6 targets and lasts about 30 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_HeatShield.label: Heat Shield
LanguageData.TM_Heater.description: Creates a dimensional pocket that taps into the Plane of Fire, generating constant heat in a confined area. The heater must be sustained by the mage - reduces max mana by 25 while active.
LanguageData.TM_Heater.label: Magical heater
LanguageData.TM_Ignite.description: Concentrates and enormous amount of heat at a focus point and then releases it. The released heat can ignite nearby creatures and will always set fire to corpses. The released heat will also dramatically increase the room temperature for any enclosed area.
LanguageData.TM_Ignite.label: Ignite
LanguageData.TM_Invisibility.description: Become invisible for 20 seconds. Any overt interaction will immediately break the spell. Clears caster from all hostile targeting.
LanguageData.TM_Invisibility.label: Invisibility
LanguageData.TM_Legion.description: Copy an ability from another fighter. All bonuses and restrictions of the copied ability apply. Only one ability may be stored at a time.
LanguageData.TM_Legion.label: Legion
LanguageData.TM_LightningTrap.description: Elemental lightning is charged inside a hardened arcane shell and placed as a trap. Arcane strands that activate the spell are extended around the trap and trigger when disturbed by enemies. Traps last indefinitely, but a mage is only able to sustain a single trap.
LanguageData.TM_LightningTrap.label: Lightning Trap
LanguageData.TM_MageLight.description:
Creates a small orb of light that banishes the darkness. Magelight will remain in the proximity of the casting mage. This spell has an upkeep cost of 10 mana and 5% mana regen.
Magelight grants a 20% vision bonus; only the caster benefits from this bonus.
Magelight can be dispelled by using this ability on the caster.
LanguageData.TM_MageLight.label: Magelight
LanguageData.TM_MagicWardrobe.description: A simple ability that stores all equipped clothing in a dimensional pocket. When used again, the stored clothing becomes equipped and any current equipment becomes stored. Works for all apparel, but not weapons or held items. Useful for storing gear or for quickly swapping between equipment sets.
LanguageData.TM_MagicWardrobe.label: Magic Wardrobe
LanguageData.TM_ManaShield.description:
Summons a protective barrier that draws power from the caster's mana. Damage absorption rate is 1dmg to 1 mana. The barrier breaks when the caster has insufficient mana to absorb an attack.
Casting the spell when a barrier is active will remove the barrier. Can be used in conjunction with shield belts. Does not impede spell casting of any type.
LanguageData.TM_ManaShield.label: Mana Shield
LanguageData.TM_MechaniteReprogramming.description: Reprograms fibrous or sensory mechanites to harmonize with a hosts biological systems. The result will significantly reduce the strain on the host while the mechanites are active.
LanguageData.TM_MechaniteReprogramming.label: Reprogram Mechanites
LanguageData.TM_PommelStrike.description:
A melee attack that delivers a non-lethal blow dealing minor damage and stunning the target for a short period.
This ability can instantly down a target pawn; the more pain the target is in, the more likely the blow will knock down the target instead of stun.
Autocast only triggers when the target has 80% or greater chance of being downed from this attack.
LanguageData.TM_PommelStrike.label: Pommel Strike
LanguageData.TM_PowerNode.description: Creates an energy node that slowly releases arcane energy in the form of electricity. Can be used as a power source. The power node must be sustained by the mage - reduces max mana by 25 and mana regen by 25% while active.
LanguageData.TM_PowerNode.label: Arcane Power Node
LanguageData.TM_SiphonMana.description: Siphons magical energy from another caster. Recipients that are not magic users will have physical capacities drained instead. Can be lethal if too much life force is drained.
LanguageData.TM_SiphonMana.label: Siphon Mana
LanguageData.TM_SmokeCloud.description: Draws in and ignites water and dirt particles in the air to create a smoke screen that temporarily conceals the area.
LanguageData.TM_SmokeCloud.label: Smoke Cloud
LanguageData.TM_SnapFreeze.description: Removes almost all heat at a focus point causing a snap freeze of any living object. Creatures may suffer from frostbite and most plant life will die. The removal of heat will also dramatically decrease the room temperature for any enclosed area.
LanguageData.TM_SnapFreeze.label: Snap Freeze
LanguageData.TM_SpellMending.description: Cast an enchantment upon a person that slowly reconstructs their equipment at a molecular level. Spell mending requires a the equipment to be worn in order to extract 'memories' from the wearer to perform the reconstruction. This places a physical strain on the affected pawn and will slow their physical activities. Spell mending dissipates after several hours.
LanguageData.TM_SpellMending.label: Spell Mending
LanguageData.TM_Sunlight.description: Creates a beacon of sunlight strong enough to grow plants. The beacon must be sustained by the mage - reduces max mana by 40 and mana regeneration by 40% while active.
LanguageData.TM_Sunlight.label: Sun Light
LanguageData.TM_TeachMagic.description:
Mentor a mage of lesser level to increase their magic skill.
Mentored mages will gain class XP. The amount of XP gained depends on the social status and difference in levels between the two mages.
LanguageData.TM_TeachMagic.label: Mentor Magic
LanguageData.TM_TeachMight.description:
Train a fighter of lesser level to increase their combat skill.
Trained fighters will gain class XP. The amount of XP gained depends on the social status and difference in levels between the two fighters.
LanguageData.TM_TeachMight.label: Combat Training
LanguageData.TM_TempestStrike.description:
Launch multiple attacks in rapid succession. Each attack consumes 20 stamina. Tempest Strike will end when the fighter has insufficient stamina or after 5 attacks.
Melee weapons generate blades of energy.
This attack only works when the weapon equipped is not normally consumed after use.
LanguageData.TM_TempestStrike.label: Tempest Strike
LanguageData.TM_ThrowingKnife.description: A ranged attack using a concealed throwing knife, designed to complement any equipped weapon system.
LanguageData.TM_ThrowingKnife.label: Throwing Knife
LanguageData.TM_TransferMana.description: Transfers magical energy from one caster to another. Recipients that are not magic users will receive significant, if random, physical augmentation for a short period. Can be harmful, even lethal, at extreme levels.
LanguageData.TM_TransferMana.label: Transfer Mana
LanguageData.TM_WetGround.description: Infuses sand with water, creating usable soil.
LanguageData.TM_WetGround.label: Moisturize Ground
